home.title: My health
home.subtitle: This is your own respiratory health record.
home.latestDescription: This is the most recent time your breathing sounds were recorded.
home.goToHeading: Where do you want to go?
home.zonesLine: {{count}} of {{total}} places on your chest were recorded.
home.quickResultsBody: See every check of your breathing sounds.
home.quickRecordingsBody: Listen to the sounds that were recorded.
home.quickHistoryBody: Your details, your past illnesses and your family's.
home.quickTrendsBody: See how your checks compare from visit to visit.
home.quickRehabBody: Breathing exercises your practitioner has given you.

results.title: My results
results.listDescription: Each row is one visit. Tap a row to see the full result.

breakdown.suggestive_one: {{count}} place: something the app wants a person to look at
breakdown.suggestive_other: {{count}} places: something the app wants a person to look at
breakdown.uncertain_one: {{count}} place: the app could not tell
breakdown.uncertain_other: {{count}} places: the app could not tell
breakdown.insufficientQuality_one: {{count}} place: the recording was not clear enough
breakdown.insufficientQuality_other: {{count}} places: the recording was not clear enough
breakdown.notAnalysed_one: {{count}} place: not checked by the app yet
breakdown.notAnalysed_other: {{count}} places: not checked by the app yet
breakdown.modelNotConnected_one: {{count}} place: the app's listening tool was not running
breakdown.modelNotConnected_other: {{count}} places: the app's listening tool was not running

results.possibleFindingIs: The app thought this sounded like: {{condition}}
results.possibleFindingNote: This is the app's guess about the sound. It is not a diagnosis and it is not a doctor's opinion.
results.modelVersionUnknown: No listening tool ran on this recording.
results.qualityBad: Not clear enough to check. Nothing was decided from this recording.
results.qualityUnknown: This recording was not given a clearness check.
results.notAnalysedBody: This recording has not been through the app's listening tool yet. Nothing has been decided about your health from it.
results.errorBody: The app could not finish checking this recording. Nothing has been decided about your health from it.
results.modelNotConnectedTitle: The app's listening tool was not running
results.modelNotConnectedBody: This recording was saved, but the part of the app that listens to it was not connected at the time. Nothing has been decided about your health from it.
results.severityBody: Ausculta does not yet work out a severity score. There is no number here, and nothing on this screen is a score.

empty.title: You have no results yet
empty.body: Results appear here after a health worker records your breathing sounds with the Ausculta device. Nothing is missing — this is simply your first visit.
empty.action: Read what Ausculta can and cannot do

notFound.title: That result is not on this device
notFound.body: The result you were looking for is not saved here. It may have been recorded on another device.

recordings.title: My recordings
recordings.heading: Every recording, newest first
recordings.description: These are the sounds the device recorded from your chest. Tap play to listen.
recordings.noAudio: The sound file for this recording is not saved on this device.
recordings.openAssessment: See the result for this visit

empty.title: You have no recordings yet
empty.body: Recordings appear here after a health worker uses the Ausculta device on your chest.

review.aiCaveat: This part was worked out by the app on its own. It is not a doctor's opinion and it is not a diagnosis.
review.practitionerCaveat: This part was written by a person — a doctor or health practitioner who looked at your recordings.

status.label: Has a person checked this?
status.PENDING_REVIEW: Waiting for a practitioner to check it
status.DISAPPROVED: A practitioner did not agree with the app
status.FURTHER_REVIEW_REQUESTED: A practitioner asked for another look

statusBody.DRAFT: This visit has not been sent for checking yet.
statusBody.PENDING_REVIEW: No person has looked at this yet. Only the app has. Please do not treat it as a medical opinion.
statusBody.APPROVED: A practitioner has read this result and agreed it can stand.
statusBody.DISAPPROVED: A practitioner read this result and did not agree with what the app heard. Follow what they told you, not the app.
statusBody.FURTHER_REVIEW_REQUESTED: A practitioner wants this looked at again, or recorded again. Please talk to your health worker.

pending.title: No practitioner has checked this yet
pending.body: Everything above came from the app by itself. A doctor or health practitioner has not reviewed it.

history.title: About me
history.name: Name
history.consentNone: No consent has been recorded on this device yet. Ask your health worker about this.
history.notAskedNote: Nobody has asked you these questions yet. That is not the same as answering no — they are simply blank.
history.noneRecorded: Nothing has been recorded here yet.
history.readOnlyNote: This page is read-only. To correct anything on it, ask your health worker.

empty.title: Your details are not on this device
empty.body: Your health worker has not registered your details here yet.

trends.title: Over time
trends.heading: How your checks compare
trends.description: Each point is one visit, oldest on the left. This shows what the app heard — it is not a measure of how well or unwell you are.
trends.findingsChartTitle: Places the app flagged for a closer look
trends.findingsChartDescription: Out of the places recorded at each visit.
trends.confidenceChartDescription: Only shown for visits where the app named something. It is how sure the app was about its own guess, not a chance of illness.
trends.confidenceNone: The app did not name anything at any of these visits, so there is nothing to show here.
trends.qualityChartTitle: How many recordings were clear enough
trends.qualityChartDescription: A visit with few clear recordings tells you less than one with many.
trends.severityBody: Ausculta does not yet work out a severity score, so there is no severity line to draw. Nothing on this page is a severity score.
trends.changeDetected: A change in the recorded breathing sound pattern was noticed between your last two visits.
trends.noChangeDetected: No change in the recorded breathing sound pattern was noticed between your last two visits.
trends.changeNote: A change in the sound pattern is not the same as your health getting better or worse. Only a practitioner can tell you that.

empty.title: Not enough visits to show a trend yet
empty.body: A trend needs at least two visits to compare. Drawing a line through a single point would suggest a direction that nobody has measured.
empty.bodyNone: You have no visits recorded yet, so there is nothing to compare.

rehab.title: Breathing plan
rehab.heading: Breathing exercises from your practitioner
rehab.whatItIs: Ausculta can carry a set of breathing exercises that a practitioner chooses for you. The exercises come from published clinical guidance, and only a practitioner can put them on your plan.

empty.title: Your practitioner has not given you a plan yet
empty.body: When a doctor or health practitioner assigns breathing exercises to you, they will appear on this page with instructions. Ausculta will not invent exercises for you — breathing exercises can be unsafe for the wrong person, so a practitioner has to choose them.

rehab.askNote: If you would like a breathing plan, ask your health worker or doctor at your next visit.
rehab.safetyBody: Read this before you need it. It explains the warning signs and what to do during an asthma attack.
rehab.safetyAction: What to do in an attack

shared.loadError: Your information could not be read from this device.
shared.aboutTitle: What Ausculta can and cannot do
shared.aboutBody: Ausculta listens to recordings of your breathing and points out sounds a person may want to look at. It cannot diagnose an illness, it can be wrong, and it does not replace a doctor or a health worker. If you feel unwell, get help even if this app shows nothing.

noRecord.title: Your health record is not linked yet
noRecord.body: Your account is not yet connected to a patient record on this device. A health worker links them when they register you. Until then there is nothing of yours to show — this is not an error.
noRecord.action: What Ausculta can and cannot do

demoPreview.title: You are looking at sample data
demoPreview.body: Your account has no patient record yet, so Ausculta is showing a made-up example so you can see how the app works. None of it is about you and none of it is real.
